To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the heart tube grows in length by accretion of cells from the secondary heart fields.

(1) myocardium is added to the heart tube by elongation from a secondary heartfield, and (2) the secondary heartfield is located in the midline of the splanchnic lateral plate mesodermal layer beneath the floor of pharyngeal endoderm.
the myocardium of all of the chambers and the outflow tract are added to the heart tube by accretion of cells from the secondary and primary heart fields.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the development of the heart, and in particular the conotruncal myocardial septa.
understanding the cellular basis of heart formation and the mechanisms that control the process of cardiogenesis.
the origin of the conotrunic myocardium and its relation to the primary heart fields and to the pharynx.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the heart tube is formed by the fusion of the two primary heart fields and the conotruncal myocardial cells are added from the secondary heart fields.
the myocardium of all parts of the developed heart arises from the primary heart field.
the heart tube forms from the bilateral primary heart fields.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
all of the cells in the myocardium of a developed heart are induced to become cardiac muscle from mesoderm.
the secondary heart field is an important source of cells for the myocardium of all of the chambers of the heart, and that the secondary myocardium may have a role in patterning the developing heart.
the heart is formed by the accretion of cells from two sources, the primary and secondary heart fields.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the myocardium of all parts of the heart tube is added secondarily to a primary heart tube.
the heart fields are not limited to the lateral plate mesenchyme, but extend into the splanchnic plate mesenchyme as well.
the heart tube is not a static structure, and that it elongates during looping by accretion of myocardial cells from the primary and secondary heart fields.
